goals.summary: Warn when OpenAPI generation encounters a route or webhook whose normalized path and method would overwrite an existing operation, especially when differing path converters collapse to the same OpenAPI path.

facets.summary: Different Starlette converters can normalize to one OpenAPI path, leaving the runtime's first-match behavior inconsistent with the spec's last-overwritten operation.
The warning should apply to collisions on an OpenAPI path-and-method combination and identify the colliding path and methods.
The reported example uses string and integer converters on the same path template; runtime selects the first route while OpenAPI retains the last registered operation.
The PR author reports adding warnings.warn() logic in OpenAPI generation for route or webhook overwrites, including an explanation of the converter mismatch.

openQuestions: Should collision handling do anything beyond warning, such as preserving or rejecting an operation?
What exact behavior is intended for collisions unrelated to differing converters?

goals.summary: Add regression coverage for converter collision detection, non-colliding routes, and matching versus differing parameter names.

facets.summary: Tests should cover collision detection, a no-collision case, and cases with the same parameter name versus different parameter names.
The PR author reports adding a dedicated regression test file for these scenarios.

openQuestions: What warning count, message content, and operation outcome should each test assert?

goals.summary: Document that different path converters on one path template collapse to the same OpenAPI path and recommend distinct parameter names.

facets.summary: The documentation should be placed under the path-parameter order guidance and include the distinct-parameter-name recommendation.
The PR author reports updating the path-parameters tutorial with this note.
